title: Idempotence violation: element with no recognized keys drops on round-trip
summary: parse() returns a Forwarded with a phantom empty element for inputs containing only unknown forward-pair names. format() emits '' for that element. Re-parsing '' yields Forwarded(elements=()), breaking AC7 round-trip idempotence.
root_cause: src/forwarded_parse/_parser.py:_parse_element() appends the element dict to the result list regardless of whether any recognised key was seen. _parse_pair() returns None for unknown keys, but the element's default values (for_=[], by/host/proto=None) make it non-empty, so _parse_forwarded() keeps it.
fix_direction: In _parse_element(), after the pair loop, return None if the element has for_=[] AND by/host/proto all None. Symmetric with _parse_pair()'s None-return for unknown keys.

title: Cross-cycle regex oracle does not resolve RFC 7230 §3.2.6 quoted-string backslash escapes
summary: The harness's reference oracle strips surrounding quotes without resolving \ and \" escapes. The real parser does resolve them. For inputs containing escape sequences inside quoted for= values, oracle and parser disagree — flagged as a mismatch (1709 instances) that masks real differences.
root_cause: benchmarks/adversarial/cycle_136/harness_cross_cycle.py:_oracle_extract_for_values performs v = v[1:-1] after a startswith/endswith quote check, with no intermediate escape-resolution pass.
fix_direction: Either (a) implement RFC 7230 §3.2.6 escape resolution in the oracle (~20 lines), or (b) loosen the harness assertion to compare oracle only on UNQUOTED for= values (~2 lines). (a) preferred.

title: random_quoted_value() may emit bodies ending in bare backslash
summary: The harness's random-quoted-value generator emits bodies that may end in a bare backslash. When wrapped in double-quotes, the result is a malformed quoted-string (RFC 7230 §3.2.6 only recognises \" and \\ as escape pairs). The parser correctly rejects these inputs.
root_cause: benchmarks/adversarial/cycle_136/_harness_common.py:random_quoted_value does not enforce 'always well-formed body' invariant for the trailing character.
fix_direction: After generating the body, if body.endswith('\\') either strip the trailing backslash or append one more safe character. ~3 lines.

title: CLI emits empty stdout for inputs that reduce to empty formatted form
summary: For inputs whose parsed form has no recognised keys (e.g. 'foo=bar'), the CLI exits 0 with empty stdout — violating the implicit contract that exit 0 + non-empty input produces non-empty stdout.
root_cause: Same root cause as F-001. The CLI calls format(parsed) then `if out: write`. For all-unknown elements format() returns '' and the if guard suppresses the write.
fix_direction: Fix F-001 (drop all-unknown elements) — this is the root cause. Then either (a) leave the CLI as-is and document exit-0-empty-stdout means empty round-trip, or (b) replace `if out:` guard with unconditional write so empty stdout never escapes.
